variants.name: baseline
variants.hypothesis: Configured M5 confirmation with the original 1R/1R trailing exit

variants.name: trail_later_1_5
variants.hypothesis: Let an M30 trade develop before trailing

variants.name: trail_later_2
variants.hypothesis: Delay trailing until a larger favorable move

variants.name: fixed_2r
variants.hypothesis: Keep the original fixed 2R target without trailing

variants.name: fresh_confirmation
variants.hypothesis: Reject confirmations that arrive late after the sweep

plan.followup_reason: Initial 90-day diagnostic failed training sample gates; older history extends training without changing hypotheses, test dates, minimum sample or selection/promotion rules.
plan.selection_rule: training net minus 0.5 realized drawdown; minimum 20 trades; drawdown <=1.25 baseline; positive net; otherwise baseline
plan.fixed_rule: aggregate development-training score; at least two-thirds of development windows with >=20 trades; positive aggregate net; aggregate drawdown sum <=1.25 baseline
plan.confirmation_amendment: Before any alternative OOS testing, six later test folds were reserved because the known baseline had only 14 trades in three folds. Minimum 20 trades and all hypotheses/risk/cost/test-date rules remain unchanged.
plan.promotion_rule: fixed candidate must improve aggregate and positive holdout net, maintain drawdown <=1.25 baseline, have >=20 holdout trades and remain positive/not worse under doubled assumed costs
plan.caveat: These dates and baseline were previously examined. Confirmation folds are reserved within this study, not genuinely new unseen market data.
